description: Create an asynchronous Feed API customer service metrics report task: feedType CUSTOMER_SERVICE_METRICS_REPORT, schemaVersion 1.0, filterCriteria with customerServiceMetricType (ITEM_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED or ITEM_NOT_RECEIVED) and evaluationMarketplaceId, optionally listingCategories or shippingRegions. Only CURRENT evaluations are supported; check ebay_get_customer_service_metric first to avoid tasks with no evaluation. acceptLanguage (eBay-required Accept-Language) defaults to EBAY_CONTENT_LANGUAGE. eBay answers 202; returns taskId and Location. Poll ebay_get_customer_service_metric_task, then download with ebay_get_feed_task_result_file. Requires sell.analytics.readonly.

acceptLanguage.description: Accept-Language header, e.g. en-US; defaults to EBAY_CONTENT_LANGUAGE (en-US)

filterCriteria.description: Report criteria; only CURRENT evaluations are available

listingCategories.description: L1 category IDs; narrows ITEM_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED reports

shippingRegions.description: ShippingRegionTypeEnum values (domestic or international); narrows ITEM_NOT_RECEIVED reports

name: ebay_create_customer_service_metric_task
